name: Steve Goorvitch
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Two

items.text: Stephen Goorvitch is an Associate Justice of the Court of Appeal, Second Appellate District, Division Two. Governor Gavin Newsom appointed him in February 2026, and the Commission on Judicial Appointments unanimously confirmed him in May 2026. He previously served as a Los Angeles Superior Court judge from 2015, presiding over civil and criminal cases. Before the bench, he was an assistant U.S. attorney, practiced at O'Melveny and Myers, clerked for federal judges, and worked at the Securities and Exchange Commission.
